100.name: SHOOTACK
100.protocolNote: DIVERGENCE D2 (plan 107): Layer B has no id 100. Its SHOOTACK is the orphan PacketType member aliased to SHOOT_ACK (id 121, two fields: time int32 + ack int16), while Layer A calls id 121 SHOOTACKCOUNTER. Layer A id 100 has no consumer and is probably stale. Preserved verbatim pending a human decision; do not renumber or delete here.
